behavior: Resident and conspicuous; usually travels through woodland and forest edge in noisy, chattering groups of 5–25 birds.
field_marks: Bright blue mantle, wings, and rump
Stout bill: black in adults, yellow in younger birds
Dark iris; orbital skin black in adults and yellow in younger birds
Strong yellow to orange-yellow legs and feet
habitat: Lowland humid and dry forest, scrub, woodland edge, plantations, and clearings; occasionally pine forest or swamp.

measurements.wingspan: Not reported; folded-wing length 13.95–14.1 cm (5.49–5.6 in)
